steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; window.__clear=()=>{const w=g.env.weather; w.cloud=w.cloudTarget=0.1; w.rain=w.rainTarget=0; w.timer=99999;}; __clear(); g.env.day=3; g.env.setTime(23.6); const p=g.world.place('tundra'); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, 0); g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.player.pitch=0.15; __rhf.settle(); return 'tundra night, kp '+g.env.spaceWeather.kp})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const M=g.meteors; const spot=M.pickFall(g.camera.position); if(!spot) return 'no spot'; M.dropStone(spot, 3); const f=g.state.meteorite; const az=Math.atan2(f.x-g.player.pos.x, -(f.z-g.player.pos.z)); g.player.yaw=-az; g.player.pitch=0.2; const k=M.streaks[0]; k.dur=80; k.t=26; return 'fireball '+f.kind+' '+f.kg+' kg at '+f.x.toFixed(0)+','+f.z.toFixed(0)})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.open('map'); const f=g.state.meteorite; g.screens.mapView.cx=f.cx; g.screens.mapView.cz=f.cz; g.screens.mapView.scale=g.screens.mapView.max*0.25; return 'map'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close(); const f=g.state.meteorite; g.env.setTime(13); g.player.place(f.x+2.2, f.z+0.4, Math.atan2(2.2, 0.4)); g.player.pitch=-0.45; __rhf.settle(); return 'by the stone'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const ia=g.interaction; const lab=ia&&ia.label; const before=g.state.money; if(ia&&ia.label==='PICK UP') ia.act(); return lab+' money '+before+' -> '+g.state.money+' log '+JSON.stringify(g.state.sky.meteorites)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __clear(); g.env.day=3; g.env.setTime(23.3); const p=g.world.place('tundra'); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, 0); const S=g.satellites; S.night=-5; S.update(0); S.pass={t0:g.env.time, az0:262, az1:96, azm:182, top:18, dur:70}; S.passT=0; S.update(0.01); S.passT=31; S.update(0.01); const v=S.issDir; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-v.x,-v.z); g.player.pitch=Math.asin(v.y); __rhf.settle(); return 'iss dir '+v.x.toFixed(2)+','+v.y.toFixed(2)+','+v.z.toFixed(2)+' visible '+S.issVisible})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const S=g.satellites; S.passT=31; const sub=g.skySubjects().map(s=>s.id).join(','); g.state.gear.camera=true; g.player.tool='camera'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.photo.zoomIndex=3; const e=g.photo.evaluate(); return 'sky subjects '+sub+' | camera on '+(e?e.id+' '+e.stars+' stars':'nothing')})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.player.tool='none'; g.photo.zoomIndex=0; const sw=g.env.spaceWeather; sw.night=g.env.spaceWeather.nightOf(g.env); sw.kp=7; sw.burst=1; g.player.yaw=0; g.player.pitch=0.35; return 'storm kp 7'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.player.yaw=Math.PI*0.9; g.player.pitch=0.8; return 'looking up with the sky guide, setting '+g.state.settings.skyGuide})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.env.setTime(14); const sw=g.solarwalk; const J=sw.signs.find(s=>s.id==='jupiter'); g.player.place(J.x+Math.sin(0)*0, J.z+0, 0); const road=g.world.roads.find(r=>r.id==='light'); const n=road.path.nearest(J.x,J.z); const p=road.path.sample(n.s); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, Math.atan2(-(J.x-p.x), -(J.z-p.z))); g.player.pitch=-0.05; __rhf.settle(); return 'jupiter sign at '+J.x.toFixed(0)+','+J.z.toFixed(0)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const sw=g.solarwalk; const S=sw.signs[0]; const road=g.world.roads.find(r=>r.id==='light'); const n=road.path.nearest(S.x,S.z); const p=road.path.sample(n.s); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, Math.atan2(-(S.x-p.x), -(S.z-p.z))); g.player.pitch=-0.12; __rhf.settle(); return 'sun sign; walk '+JSON.stringify(g.state.sky.walk)})()
